qualification.education_qualification: 4 year UG in Mechanical/Applied Mechanics/Chemical Engineering, ME/MTech or equivalent Master's in Thermofluidics, Good understanding of fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, and heat transfer, Expertise in programming (C++/Py) and CFD simulations (optional), Training in molecular dynamics (MD) simulations (priority)
qualification.details: 4 year UG in Mechanical/Applied Mechanics/Chemical Engineering. Additionally, either a 2-year experience OR an ME/MTech/any equivalent Master's preferably specialized in Thermofluidics. Candidate should have a good understanding of the fundamentals of fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, and heat transfer. (Optional) Expertise in programming (C++/Py) and CFD simulations. Candidates trained in molecular dynamics (MD) simulations will be given priority over others.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Madras Project Officer Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 23-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Project Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IIT Madras Project Officer recruitment is 23-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Officer post?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Project Officer post at IIT Madras.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Officer position?
faq.answer: A 4-year UG degree in Mechanical, Applied Mechanics, or Chemical Engineering is required, along with an ME/MTech or equivalent Master's, preferably in Thermofluidics, or 2 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Officer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 27,500 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Officer position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an online application, followed by document verification, and a test or interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely online through the official IIT Madras website.

faq.question: Q8. Does IIT Madras offer age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Age relaxation details are not explicitly mentioned in the provided data, and candidates should refer to the official notification for specifics.

faq.question: Q9. Are candidates with programming or CFD simulation experience preferred?
faq.answer: Yes, expertise in programming (C++/Py) and CFD simulations is considered optional, and candidates trained in molecular dynamics (MD) simulations will be given priority.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification and the online application link are available in the "Important Links" section of this article.
